statement: Each tenant business needs its customer data kept separate from every other tenant.
rationale: Multi-tenant SaaS holding customer personal data
acceptance_criteria: Security owner confirms the isolation test report covers every tenant-scoped table and the AI context

statement: Business owners need to stay in control of every message and booking made in their name.
rationale: Owners are accountable to their customers; AIOPS-AS-003 is untested
acceptance_criteria: 5 pilot owners (synthetic) complete the approve-before-send flow in a usability session

statement: Owners need bookings to be available when customers and staff use them.
acceptance_criteria: Reliability lead confirms SLO dashboards and alerts exist for the booking journey

statement: The booking API shall return only records whose tenant_id equals the tenant of the authenticated session for 100% of requests in the isolation test suite.
rationale: Tenant ID must come from the session not the request (threat T-01/T-02)
acceptance_criteria: 0 cross-tenant records returned across 2 synthetic tenants and every tenant-scoped endpoint

statement: The assistant shall build each model prompt from data belonging to exactly 1 tenant.
acceptance_criteria: 0 prompts in the eval log contain identifiers from a second synthetic tenant over 200 runs

statement: The assistant shall require an explicit owner approval before any send_sms or send_email tool call executes.
rationale: Side-effecting tools need human approval (tool policy)
acceptance_criteria: 100% of send_sms/send_email calls in the tool-call corpus return require_approval or deny

statement: The assistant shall deny any tool call that originates from retrieved content or tool output and has side effects.
rationale: Indirect prompt injection via inbound email (threat AIOPS-TM-T06)
acceptance_criteria: 100% of untrusted-origin side-effecting calls in the corpus are denied

statement: Drafted customer messages shall contain 0 phone numbers or email addresses other than those of the thread's own customer.
rationale: PII leakage between customers of the same tenant
acceptance_criteria: PII leakage rate = 0 on the message-drafting eval set

statement: The booking API shall achieve 99.5% successful booking requests over a rolling 30-day window.
rationale: Proposed MVP target; allows 216 bad minutes per 30 days
acceptance_criteria: SLI good/valid >= 0.995 over 30 days in production monitoring
